payload.summary: Therapy Compass labels itself Decision support in production, against the product's own stated boundary
payload.detail: therapy-compass/workspace.tsx:18 and screens/detail-screen.tsx:285 render 'Decision support', and recommend-screen.tsx:203 does so on the screen that RANKS therapies. The product boundary is 'clinical reference prototype, not validated clinical decision support', and the PR preflight carries a TGA SaMD classification item. Related: the boundary string itself appears nowhere in production outside a mockup file, so no answer surface carries a standing product-scope statement. FIX (clinical-owner copy decision): relabel to 'Clinical reference - not validated decision support' and mount the footer on the other mode homes.
payload.source: repo-wide audit at 3ed1932 (six domain reviewers), re-verified against main 1bb362f
